Documentation:
Events can only be triggered in order.
You can set a minimum amount of days between events (default is 1 --> means you need to sleep at least once before being able to trigger the next event.)
[i](Emily always has post event dialogue. Some events have other villagers also have post event dialogue)
[/i][u][b]ATTENTION:[/b][/u] Event 9 and 10 are romance focused. The friendship route ends a event 8.

Frequently asked questions:

[u]Q:[/u] Is the mod compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿?
[u]A:[/u] [color=#93c47d]Yes![/color] The events account for if Stardew Expanded is installed or not.

[u]Q:[/u] Can I stay platonic friends with Emily after 8 Hearts?
[u]A:[/u] [color=#cc4125]No.[/color][color=#93c47d] [/color][color=#efefef]If you want to stay friends with Emily stop after Event 8. it is also a nice ending, imo. :3[/color]

[u]Q:[/u] Will the Vanilla Stardew Events with Emily be replaced?
[u]A:[/u] [color=#cc4125]No! [/color]This mod only adds more events and does not change any existing events.

[u]Q:[/u] Is the mod compatible with any other Emily story mod﻿?
[u]A:[/u] [color=#93c47d]Yes! [/color]This mod only adds more events and does not change anything about Emily.
     Not sure if the stories will always fit.

[u]Q:[/u] Can I make a translation for this mod?
[u]A:[/u] [color=#93c47d]Yes![/color] I am really thankful for any translation.
     Please read the permissions and credits tab first! [b][u](no AI).[/u][/b]
     Please make sure to use the correct i18n format.
     If you want to use the artwork for your translation or other mod, make sure to credit the original artist.

[u]Q:[/u] Can I use your assets?
[u]A:[/u] Short answer is [color=#cc4125]no.[/color] But you can reach out to me on Discord to ask for permission (username: [url=https://discordapp.com/users/311172683679268865/]Miihau[/url]).

[u]Q:[/u] Is this mod compatible with mobile?
[u]A:[/u] I think so? So far all of my event mods worked on mobile so I believe this on will as well. 

Q: Can I still see the events if I'm already married to Emily (or on an already existing save file)?
A: [color=#93c47d]Yes![/color] You can still see all the event in the intended order.

[u]Q:[/u] Will Emily's behavior change?
[u]A:[/u] [color=#cc4125]No![/color] This mod does not change her behavior (schedule, gift taste, etc.).

[u]Q:[/u] Can I use your mod as a template to learn?
[u]A:[/u] Sure, feel free to learn from it. Just don't blatantly copy whole chunks.

[u]Q:[/u] Will you make a mod for [insert your favorite NPC here]?
[u]A:[/u] So far I have mods for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17674][u]Haley[/u][/url]﻿, [u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18657]Abigail[/url]﻿[/u], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16279][u]Penny[/u][/url]﻿, [u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28299]Leah[/url]﻿[/u] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24068][u]Shane[/u][/url]. (and now also Emily)
     I really want to make a mod for all the NPCs.
     Upcoming NPC I have an eye on are Harvey, Sebastian or Maru.
     You can vote for who I mod next on my [url=https://miihau.com/home/?tab=modvotebtn]Website[/url].
